source: All project-owned Razor views, page models, Program.cs and wwwroot/css/ontario.css; no project-owned JS files outside inline Razor scripts.

checks.imageAlt: No img elements; decorative ON mark aria-hidden=true; logo anchor has an accessible name.
checks.tabindex: No positive tabindex; main, summary, confirmation use -1 for programmatic focus; table scroll region uses 0.
checks.titles: Every page sets ViewData Title; server rejection and confirmation have state-specific titles; client rejection does not, recorded with A11Y-013.
checks.labels: Four visible asp-for labels; rendered labels, required, name/email autocomplete and stable describedby IDs verified.
checks.errors: Field relations and invalid state pass; client notification fails on exact path in A11Y-013.
checks.table: Caption and scoped column headings present; a simple column-header table does not require row th solely because a reference column exists. Labeled keyboard scroll region works.
checks.headings: One h1 per rendered state, no skipped heading levels.
checks.focus: Native auto focus outline retained on links/buttons; screenshots confirm a contrasting white component on dark surfaces despite computed auto outline RGB. Authored form outlines are solid 3px with a yellow halo.
checks.textContrast: No axe violations; hero gradient manually bounded at 11.42:1 for #333 text and 15.74:1 for #1a text. Opaque textarea colors manually checked. See manual-contrast.json.
checks.layout: All states pass normal 320px reflow; error prose overflows with spacing overrides, A11Y-014.
checks.duplicateLinks: Privacy links still need content/context review, A11Y-011.

excludedFalseAlarms: Offscreen skip link is deliberately 1x1 when unfocused; first Tab reveals it and Enter focuses main. It is not a clipped-text/target-size defect.
Native auto focus computed RGB alone does not describe the white contrast edge visible in Chromium screenshots.
Table horizontal scrolling is contained and exempt; no body horizontal overflow in the seeded table state.
axe gradient/textarea contrast incomplete results were manually assessed, not counted as violations.
coverageLimits: No exhaustive browser/AT or forced-colors matrix
No exhaustive combinations of arbitrary user-entered content
